claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch because aggregate readiness is above threshold, rollout is bounded and reversible, and the known developer-support migration limitation is handled appropriately so long as it is explicitly disclosed in the model card and monitored.
specific_concerns: I only have the Actor's summary, not the underlying evidence contents, so I cannot independently verify the cited facts or the policy/application link.

The policy text provided says rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed unless exposure is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance exists; the summary says the segment remains exposed and risk acceptance is neither approved nor applicable.

The recommendation to certify is only plausibly supportable if explicit model-card disclosure is actually included, but no admissible evidence here shows that the disclosure has been completed or formally committed.
The Actor's packet appears more defensible as a conditional certification rationale than as unconditional support for certification.
unsupported_claims: The exact quantitative assertions such as clearing readiness by 2.5 percentage points and beginning at 7% rollout are not independently verifiable from the admissible record available to me.
That the current risk-acceptance draft does not address the exposed segment is not independently verifiable without the underlying draft or review record.
That certification is presently justified, rather than justified only if disclosure is included, is not fully supported by the available admissible evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying contents of each cited evidence item, especially the aggregate readiness result, rehearsal incident report, rollout plan, current-gap record, and policy artifact.
Provide the actual model-card text or release artifact showing the known limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide approval status and scope of any risk-acceptance record, including whether it covers the exposed developer-support migration segment.
Provide evidence showing whether the affected segment is included or excluded from the initial rollout cohort.
decision_criteria: If underlying evidence confirms readiness, bounded rollout, exposed segment status, and policy language, then monitoring plus rollback alone is insufficient unless the segment is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance exists.
If the model card already contains explicit disclosure of the known limitation, conditional certification could be supportable.
If no disclosure exists and no approved risk acceptance covers the exposed segment, certification is not adequately supported under the stated policy.
Independent support requires more than the Actor's characterization of evidence; the underlying records must substantiate the material predicates.
